components.name: Reading navigation
components.description: Compact green section links with visible keyboard focus.

components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;gap:32px;font-size:14px;font-weight:550;font-family:"PingFang TC","Noto Sans TC","Microsoft JhengHei",system-ui,sans-serif;}.ds-nav a{color:var(--green);padding:6px 0;text-decoration:none;transition:color .18s ease-out,background .18s ease-out}.ds-nav a:hover{color:#0b4736;text-decoration:underline}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #428a6b;outline-offset:5px;border-radius:2px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-nav a{transition:none}}

components.css: .ds-disclosure{border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-family:"PingFang TC","Noto Sans TC","Microsoft JhengHei",system-ui,sans-serif;}.ds-disclosure summary{cursor:pointer;color:var(--green);padding:13px 0;font-weight:600}.ds-disclosure summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #428a6b;outline-offset:5px;border-radius:2px}.ds-disclosure pre{background:var(--tint);font:12px/1.65 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Consolas,monospace;padding:18px;border-radius:var(--radius);white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;max-height:560px;overflow:auto}

narrative.overview: Read-mode Traditional Chinese content on white, with restrained green headings and evidence regions. User approved B 前後對照 for this surface. The north-star name is descriptive documentation rather than a new user-approved slogan.
keyCharacteristics: Flat tint surfaces and fine dividers
Desktop comparison; stacked mobile with full-width caption

rules.name: Written Status Rule
rules.body: Use written 本機 and 待完成 statuses; color alone cannot imply completed testing.

rules.name: Reading Measure Rule
rules.body: Constrain prose to 74ch while comparison and evidence span the container.

dos: Do preserve reading hierarchy and evidence source notes.
Do retain the full-width mobile caption.
donts: Do not claim LINE真人測試 from local outputs.
Do not invent quantitative visual validation.
